moments.author: Senator Bernie Sanders
moments.quote: If the leaders of the major AI companies acknowledge that they are losing control… it is irresponsible for society to allow them to move forward…
moments.why: This tweet introduced the ‘Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act,’ sparking massive debate about AI safety and regulation.

moments.author: Representative Greg Casar
moments.quote: Artificial superintelligence would risk the security, freedom, and lives of Americans. Bernie Sanders and I are introducing a bill to ban it.
moments.why: Casar’s post went viral within AI and tech policy circles, reinforcing the legislative push and driving widespread engagement.

moments.author: Ryan Garcia
moments.quote: This dude looks like he’s about to pass out right now in the sun (on Conor Benn looking like Handsome Squidward)
moments.why: Boxing fans are buzzing over this hilarious shade aimed at Conor Benn, blending pop culture and fight hype.

moments.author: Simone Biles
moments.quote: You should be uplifting the trans community… maybe a transgender category IN ALL sports!!
moments.why: Her blistering response to Riley Gaines reignited a fierce debate over trans inclusion in sports.
